extension.description: A plugin that allows to browse and play items from a video library on an external Kodi instance.
Ett tillägg som gör det möjligt att bläddra och spela upp objekt från ett videobibliotek på en extern Kodi-instans.
extension.news: 1.1.32: - Remove redundant code, unused components, and temporary diagnostic logging. Simplify monitor matching by reusing the existing listing data instead of re-reading memory storage, and fix a lint configuration error. 1.1.31: - Fix automatic watched-state updates for an item resolved by another add-on (such as a OneDrive or Google Drive .strm). The player reports only that add-on's local stream URL, so the item is now also identified by its file name, used only when that name matches exactly one row. A name shared by two rows is never guessed. 1.1.30: - Diagnostic build: re-read the playing path and player item every second and log changes. 1.1.29: - Restore direct online row playback so Kodi's native resume uses the row ListItem. 1.1.28: - Keep direct VFS playback and pass resume choices through the player start position. 1.1.27: - Fix playback handoff resolution so normal Play and Play from here return the direct stream. 1.1.26: - Preserve resume playback when carrying movie and episode IDs through the playback handoff. 1.1.24: - Carry the movie id through playback like episodes, so a movie's watched state updates on the remote host; and re-watching a finished episode now moves its last played date too. 1.1.17: - Refresh last played after meaningful playback while preserving the existing watched state. 1.1.16: - Pressing Back into a list you have already opened is fast again: Kodi's own saved copy of the finished listing is used once more (it had been turned off in 1.1.12). An empty or failed listing is never saved, so a build that failed on an offline host is not remembered as empty. 1.1.15: - Fix the smart playlist view with "Use the native library view" on: the playlist's content type was declared in a form Kodi does not recognise, so the movie / TV show view types (Widelist, Shift and the like) were missing from the view list and the year was not shown. 1.1.14: - New "Use the native library view" setting: with it on, every list (including smart playlists) is drawn in Kodi's native library view; with it off they use the generic file view, which can be quicker to draw. - While the local copy of the Movies or TV Shows library does not exist yet, a "Build local copy" option appears in that root entry's context menu, so it can be built without opening the list and waiting. Once the copy exists the option is no longer shown. - Smart playlist rows can now show the full details (poster, plot, all metadata) taken from the local copy, matched by item id, instead of only the few fields the playlist itself returns. This can be turned off to draw the lean rows. 1.1.13: - Smart playlists on the remote Kodi host can be browsed from a "Smart Playlists" menu and opened as lists, with posters and plots read straight from the host. - Any playlist can be pinned to the root menu from its context menu. - Playlists are paginated (30 items, then a configurable page size); paging can be turned off. 1.1.12: - Fixes section show/hide toggles (and other list changes) only taking effect after a restart: Kodi's own cached copy of a listing is no longer used, so every folder open reflects the current settings. 1.1.11: - Playing an item while the remote Kodi host is offline now shows a notification instead of freezing the player on an unreachable URL. - Opening a list while the host is offline now gives up on the remote check after a few seconds instead of ten, so the local copy is shown sooner. - The "Fast lists" setting has been removed: it saved little and broke sorting by date added / last played. The full info popup and all sort options are back. 1.1.9: - No longer refresh the list after playback ends, which removes the multi-second freeze on exit. The watched tick updates the next time the list is opened. - Remote requests now time out, so an unreachable host no longer hangs the interface. 1.1.3: - Movies and TV Shows lists are now served from a local copy, so they open instantly. - Only library changes are fetched from the remote Kodi host on each list open. 1.1.2: - Refresh movies/episodes list after resume/playback state has been updated.
